propositions: The epic's headline AC requires bidirectional reconciliation live against a realistic store copy, proven by inbound create and outbound edit round-tripping, which an empty-store pass cannot establish

The reconciler must be isolated from the production project via a separate git-initialized repo with no remotes, scrubbed of all .bridge_state bindings and prev_snapshot artifacts before the pass runs

A scrubbed copy of the project's actual 2600+ ticket store is fetched from the orphan tickets branch, extracted into .tickets-tracker/, and its integrity is verified by counting local entries against the fetched tree
The mutation suite runs 28 cells spanning 14 inbound and 14 outbound mutations, each individually asserted against a named oracle, scoped with --filter-local-ids to prevent mass spurious creates
Multi-page pagination is exercised by observing the instance's effective page size, seeding 2*observed+1 issues, and asserting all seeded issues are recovered in the inbound fetch
